orders.title: Light the Brazier
orders.blurb: Six Gem Shards, Keeper. That brazier has been cold since the last keeper fled — light it, and I will part with something I have kept far too long.

orders.title: Warm the Long Hearth
orders.blurb: Your little dragon keeps coughing up shards — good. Forge me THREE Flame Gems and the hall will be warm by supper.

orders.title: Catch the Moonwater
orders.blurb: The basin on the high ground fills whether anyone watches it or not. Three drops make a vial, three vials make Moonwater — bring me one, and I will show you what the moon does with borrowed light.

orders.title: Craft the Radiant Centerpiece
orders.blurb: One Radiant Gem. One. Merge three Flame Gems into something the old court would have stopped talking to look at.

orders.title: What She Keeps
orders.blurb: Two baskets, and I will put them by rather than eat them. A larder is not what you have — it is what you did not need today.

orders.title: Fill the Keeper's Hoard
orders.blurb: An encore, Keeper — three Radiant Gems. A proper hoard for a proper Keep, and proof enough for anyone still watching.

orders.title: Set Two Marks
orders.blurb: You came a long way to stand on nine feet of ice. Bring me two of the netted floats and I will hang them where the light carries — then the coast is yours to walk. The door comes later, if I like what you do with it.

orders.title: Feed the Northern Dragons
orders.blurb: Mine eat pitch, not berries. Nothing grows here, so the fire has to be dug up before it can be fed — three loaves of it. That is the whole north in one errand.

orders.title: Salvage the Wrecks
orders.blurb: Two banded helms. Every wreck brings iron ashore, and iron is the one thing the ice does not eat. Bring them up before the tide has another think.

orders.title: What She Will Take
orders.blurb: Two buoys, netted and hung. Bring them up the shingle yourself — I want to see whether you carry a load the same way you merge one.

orders.title: Weave the Aurora
orders.blurb: Two cloaks, woven tight. My sister catches light and keeps it in glass; I catch it on a warp and it keeps something warm. Bring me these and I will tell you what I have been keeping.

repeatable.title: More Gem Shards
repeatable.blurb: The brazier is hungry again. Eight Gem Shards, if your dragons would be so kind.

repeatable.title: More Flame Gems
repeatable.blurb: Two Flame Gems for the gallery alcoves. I want the light back in that corridor.

repeatable.title: More Dragon Rubies
repeatable.blurb: Five Dragon Rubies. Ask the red one — she hoards them anyway.

repeatable.title: Another Radiant Gem
repeatable.blurb: Another Radiant Gem, Keeper. The Keep can never be too bright, and I sleep better for it.

repeatable.title: More Glass Floats
repeatable.blurb: Eight floats off the tide line. The marks do not hang themselves.

repeatable.title: More Pitch Loaves
repeatable.blurb: Two more loaves. They have been out in it all night and they are not sentimental about who feeds them.

repeatable.title: More Light Threads
repeatable.blurb: Five threads. I weave in the evenings. It is not a hobby.

repeatable.title: Another Ember Heart
repeatable.blurb: One ember heart. Keep it away from the weave, and away from me.
